scope: New local two-fixed-key mechanistic test, not P1B/v11 reproduction, not weight editing, no Codex
source_access: Complete model source read via GitHub connector in two slices; direct raw retrieval unavailable. Executable comparator is a documented transcription, not imported repository module.
query_order: two sequential queries in independent randomized order; no state cloning between role queries
noise_contract: Per-step independent uniform bounded increments to normalized u, m0=2A0/5-1,m1=2A1/5-1; no process noise in refractory coordinate. Increment is after deterministic threshold/reset update and before storage quantization. Voltage measurements use candidate pre-reset voltage (or 0 in refractory) at steps10/100 before this step process noise, plus bounded measurement error. Identical streams across models.
state: u,A0,A1,r: 4 signed int32 fixed-point codes in finite_bounded, float64 states in clean. Original comparator uses u,A0,r and inert A1 only for equal envelope. New models repurpose A0 and add A1 as content modes; r remains refractory timer. Intermediate arithmetic is float64, not physical fixed-bit circuit.
modified_write: m_i += dt*(event*g_i*psi(v-m_i) - (1-event*g_i)*m_i/tauH). WHQ psi=.25*tanh(error/.25); EMA psi=clip(error/1ms,-.25,.25).
modified_query: during cue Iquery=.5+.6*dot(g(query),m); during encoding/hold Iquery=0; original u/r leak-threshold-reset equation reused. m states leak at tauH in cue. Query reads two voltage samples with fixed analytic filter, no access to memory state.
original_diagnostic: Auxiliary affine-only readout from [1, observed_q, sample10, sample100], fitted once on independent 128 clean 0ms histories; no clipping or tuning. Not the original P1B decoder and not the repaired model.
randomness: numpy.random.RandomState, split seed for values/order/query jitter; noise seed = split_seed+10000+delay_steps. Same noise across model/negative-control variants. Noise/parameters never tuned.

negative_control.description: Replace each requested key by the other fixed center plus same query jitter, target unchanged. Same samples/time/current bounds; no new state.

endpoints.rmse: all queried target values; always include both queries per history
endpoints.history_complete: both absolute errors strictly below .05; silence is not substituted for a completed analog query
endpoints.retention: diagnostic m_i versus keyed target after encoding, delay and both queries; NOT exposed to decoder
endpoints.bounds: all histories attempted; boundary/candidate/spike/quantization logs; no posthoc exclusion

decision: Local success only if bounded_WHQ finite_bounded has RMSE<=.03 and history completion>=.90 at BOTH 0 and50ms and beats paired zero RMSE; 200ms stress and wrong-query reported regardless. Compare EMA descriptively, no claim of TAN-specific advantage unless measured. No original P1B threshold changed.

statistics.unit: entire history with both queries; resample together across conditions for paired contrasts; fixed sample, no optional stopping

safety_stop: Source scalar/vector agreement or decoder identity fails -> stop; nonfinite/out-of-int32 -> stop; any clip/spike in repaired branch reported as failure of subthreshold interpretation not silently dropped. No hyperparameter search.
budget: Small CPU arrays only, no gradients, no neural training, no GPU, no purchases, no repo modifications
resource_caveat: Two hard-wired centers and bandwidth are an explicit finite key prior shared with EMA; no new continuous-key binding. Explicit write/cue timing controls, longer hold lifetime, analog samples and +1 persistent state are charged. No physical energy equivalence claim.
